'If an attack reaction has been played or activated this chain link, this gets +1{d}. Blade Break' -- Blade Break is a printed keyword and fires from the card DB, deliberately not authored.

THE WINDOW IS A CHAIN LINK, not a turn: a turn holds several links and a per-turn record would keep the bonus alive for the rest of the combat. combat.link_plays is the per-link record (CR 7.0.3e records a play against the ACTIVE chain link). IS_DEFENDING_CARD is what scopes the bonus to the moment this equipment actually defends -- an ungated RECALC_DEFENSE static would move the defending TOTAL whoever was defending.
